> DSH-Portable 是独立社区发行版，内置官方 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5`。 ## 本次变化 恢复 Windows 原生右键菜单，取消第三方插件默认安装，并接入官方 rc.5 内核。 ### 修复与改进 - Windows：恢复输入框和选中文字的原生右键菜单，提供剪切、复制、粘贴和全选；沿用现有下载与保存处理。 - 内核：新包默认采用官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5；内核资格不再由可选插件的版本名单决定。 - 插件：新包不再默认安装 Image Viewer 和 Chat Manager；保留已有安装、版本和启用选择，常规管理使用官方页面，新配置首次启动即可进入。 - 插件入口：移除现代界面的重复高级管理；「更多」仅兼容恢复旧版插件 JSON 配置，日常备份恢复统一使用设置中的「桌面与数据」。 - 配置恢复：部分依赖失败时保持有效 bundle 顺序，完全失败时还原原配置并准确提示；收紧 profile 和恢复目标的路径与链接检查。 - 缓存整理：识别官方空插件安装状态，避免误报引用缺失；空配置不执行依赖清理，保留已有恢复材料。 ## 升级与验证 ### 升级说明 - 正常退出后更新；已有会话、设置、凭据、插件和工作区保留。 - 新包内置 rc.5；升级若选择保留当前内核，运行版本仍以保留结果为准，可在内核更新中另行选择。 - 旧内核更新包若提示尚未适配，请重新下载对应版本的适配包，避免旧应用层覆盖本版修复。 正式成品已通过 Windows、macOS、Linux x64 与 ARM64 验收。升级会保留会话、设置、凭据、插件和工作区。 ### 致谢 - 感谢 [@ASg-art-max](https://github.com/ASg-art-max) 在 [#236](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/issues/236) 报告 Windows 右键菜单问题。 ## 下载 [**Windows x64 便携版（推荐）**](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/releases/download/v0.9.9/DSH-Portable-windows-x64.exe) 双击后会在旁边准备可移动的 `DSH-Portable` 文件夹。以后直接运行文件夹中的 `DeepSeek-Herness.exe`。

[安全策略](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/blob/main/SECURITY.md) · [代码签名策略](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/blob/main/CODE_SIGNING.md) --- ## English > DSH-Portable is an independent community distribution bundled with official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5`. ## Changes Restores Windows native context menus, makes community plugins optional, and adopts official core rc.5. ### Fixes and improvements - Windows: restores native editing menus for the composer and selected text, with Cut, Copy, Paste and Select all, while retaining the existing download/save handling. - Core: new packages bundle official DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5. Optional plugin version lists no longer govern core qualification. - Plugins: new packages no longer install Image Viewer or Chat Manager by default. Existing installations, versions and enabled choices are preserved; official management is available on the first launch of a fresh profile. - Plugin entry points: removes duplicate modern management. More only imports legacy plugin JSON configurations; routine backup and recovery use Desktop & data in Settings. - Recovery: preserves selected bundle order during partial fallback, restores the previous configuration on complete failure, and validates profile paths and filesystem links. - Cache maintenance: recognizes official empty plugin installations without a false missing-reference error. Empty graphs skip dependency pruning and preserve existing recovery material. ## Upgrade and verification ### Upgrade notes - Exit normally before updating. Existing sessions, settings, credentials, plugins and workspaces are preserved. - The package bundles rc.5. If an upgrade preserves the current core, the running version follows that result; choose another core separately in core updates. - If an older core update file is reported as unqualified, download its refreshed package to preserve this release’s Portable fixes. Stable artifacts are verified on Windows, macOS, Linux x64, and Linux ARM64. Upgrading preserves sessions, settings, credentials, plugins, and the workspace. ### Acknowledgements - Thanks to [@ASg-art-max](https://github.com/ASg-art-max) for reporting the Windows context-menu issue in [#236](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/issues/236). ### Downloads [**Windows x64 portable edition (recommended)**](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/releases/download/v0.9.9/DSH-Portable-windows-x64.exe) Run it once to create a movable `DSH-Portable` folder beside the launcher. Afterwards, start `DeepSeek-Herness.exe` inside that folder.

> DSH-Portable 是独立社区发行版，内置官方 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`。 ## 本次变化 为 Windows Native 补齐 Portable 与内核的离线更新入口，开放通用窗口接口，并精简菜单文案。 ### 修复与改进 - 离线更新：帮助菜单与新版设置页可选择本地清单，复用现有签名校验、更新事务、健康检查和回滚；旧内核设置页也可通过宿主菜单更新。 - 窗口自定义：提供可探测的窗口栏、拖动、控制、状态与既有菜单接口，由用户插件决定外观；默认保留原生窗口，并提供托盘恢复入口。 - 窗口一致性：标题按钮、菜单与插件共用窗口操作，修正全屏中切换最大化的状态冲突，以及恢复窗口栏意外还原窗口的问题。 - 界面：缩短菜单描述，下拉菜单按内容收窄；复用官方气泡加号图标，侧栏收起后才显示顶部新会话入口，后退和前进移至视图菜单；参考官方桌面端统一栏高、字号、浅深配色与留白。 - 版本选择：本机版本领先公开更新目录时，默认保留并标注当前版本，避免误选旧版；主动降级仍有明确提示。 - 稳定性：本机健康检查使用独立连接，避免空闲连接失效时误报启动中；关闭窗口优先等待 WebView 释放资源，再决定是否需要安全回收。 ## 升级与验证 ### 升级说明 - 内置 DSH 仍为 0.2.1-rc.2，沿用既有默认插件与外壳契约 2；可选内核只提供已通过对应平台资格的版本。 - 离线更新须同时准备原始清单、原始签名与对应 ZIP；完整包和组件包不能互换，不能绕过平台或运行时兼容性检查。 - 升级前正常退出应用并备份重要数据；升级保留现有会话、设置、凭据、插件和工作区。 正式成品已通过 Windows、macOS、Linux x64 与 ARM64 验收。升级会保留会话、设置、凭据、插件和工作区。 ### 已知限制 - 通用窗口接口仅由 Windows Native 声明；浏览器、macOS、Linux 和旧宿主须按能力探测保留系统窗口。 - 1.x 官方 Electron 内核仍内置受影响的 MCP client/core 2.2.0，等待官方修复后重新验收；本次 0.x 发布不修改官方 ASAR，也不解除 1.x 发布阻断。0.x 已在 0.9.4 更新至修复版本 2.3.0。 ### 致谢 - 感谢 [ArtificialAngels 在 PR #181](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/pull/181) 提出的窗口桥接与菜单复用思路。 ## 下载 [**Windows x64 便携版（推荐）**](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/releases/download/v0.9.5/DSH-Portable-windows-x64.exe) 双击后会在旁边准备可移动的 `DSH-Portable` 文件夹。以后直接运行文件夹中的 `DeepSeek-Herness.exe`。

The host menu remains available with older core settings pages. - Window customization: discoverable capabilities expose window chrome, dragging, controls, state and existing menus. User plugins choose the appearance; native controls remain the default, with manual recovery from the tray. - Consistent controls: caption buttons, menus and plugins share window actions, fixing maximize state conflicts during fullscreen and unintended window restoration when recovering native chrome. - Interface: shorter labels and content-sized dropdowns reduce crowding. The original bubble-plus icon appears in the title bar when the sidebar is collapsed; Back and Forward move to the View menu. Bar height, text size, light/dark colors and spacing follow the official desktop. - Version selection: keep the installed version selected and marked as current when it is ahead of the public catalog. Explicit downgrades retain their warning. - Stability: local health probes use fresh connections to avoid reporting startup after an idle socket expires. Selectable cores remain limited to versions qualified for each platform. - Offline updates require the original manifest, signature and matching ZIP. Full packages and component packages are not interchangeable; platform and runtime compatibility checks still apply. - Exit normally and back up important data before upgrading. Sessions, settings, credentials, plugins and the workspace are preserved. Stable artifacts are verified on Windows, macOS, Linux x64, and Linux ARM64. This 0.x release does not modify the official ASAR; 0.x already adopted fixed SDK 2.3.0 in 0.9.4. ### Acknowledgements - Thanks to [ArtificialAngels and PR #181](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/pull/181) for the window bridge and menu reuse proposal. ### Downloads [**Windows x64 portable edition (recommended)**](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/releases/download/v0.9.5/DSH-Portable-windows-x64.exe) Run it once to create a movable `DSH-Portable` folder beside the launcher. > DSH-Portable 是独立社区发行版，内置官方 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`。 ## 本次变化 修复 Windows 任务栏按钮没有名字、窗口最大化时盖住任务栏的问题；可选的内核版本从 3 个增加到 5 个。 ### 修复与改进 - Windows：任务栏按钮现在显示「DeepSeek Harness」，不再只有图标。窗口里仍不重复画标题栏。 - Windows：窗口最大化时停在屏幕工作区内，不再延伸到任务栏下面，任务栏和托盘图标保持可见。高分屏（例如 200% 缩放）上同样适用。 - 内核：设置里可选的内核版本从最新 3 个增加到最新 5 个，并保证其中至少有 2 个 RC 或正式版，alpha 不会把它们挤出去。新增的版本由内核库自动验证后补上。 ## 升级与验证 ### 升级说明 - 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。整包更新后会自动恢复你选的内核。 正式成品已通过 Windows、macOS、Linux x64 与 ARM64 验收。升级会保留会话、设置、凭据、插件和工作区。 ## 下载 [**Windows x64 便携版（推荐）**](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/releases/download/v0.9.3/DSH-Portable-windows-x64.exe) 双击后会在旁边准备可移动的 `DSH-Portable` 文件夹。以后直接运行文件夹中的 `DeepSeek-Herness.exe`。

Cards show 30-day downloads, yearly downloads, stars and a preview; click a preview to enlarge it and page through every image; sort by default order, release date, 30-day downloads, yearly downloads or stars. Installing a core keeps the shell's own version and preinstalled plugin list. Before switching, your installed plugins are checked against the new core: if they cannot load the update is cancelled and rolled back, and plugins whose version ranges no longer fit are listed afterwards. The preinstalled Image Viewer 0.1.15 and Chat Manager 1.5.16 are adapted to it. Historical session migration was verified on the real core. - Plugin market fixes: uninstalling a plugin records the config rows it inserted before deleting it, so no orphan rows remain; a release your download mirror has not synced yet says to retry later; when download counts are rate-limited only the missing batches are retried, so heavily downloaded plugins no longer sort last for the whole day. ## Upgrade and verification ### Upgrade notes - Upgrading keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace. After a full update your chosen core is restored automatically. - Existing users get the official Discover page and the Awesome DSH catalog once after upgrading; if you turn it off on the Plugins page or remove the catalog source, it is not switched back. Stable artifacts are verified on Windows, macOS, Linux x64, and Linux ARM64. > DSH-Portable 是独立社区发行版，内置官方 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`。 ## 本次变化 新增官方 0.2.1-alpha.4 内核，登录自动打开浏览器，启动更快，更新页和更新提示更清楚。 ### 修复与改进 - 内核：新增可选内核 0.2.1-alpha.4（官方最新测试版）；可选内核保留最新三个，并始终包含最新的 RC 版 0.2.0-rc.2。预装的图片查看器升到 0.1.11、会话管理升到 1.5.12，都已适配 alpha.4。 - 登录：点击登录后会自动在默认浏览器里打开登录页，不用再手动复制链接，登录窗口也不会一直转圈等不到页面。 - 启动更快：同一台电脑上后台就绪约快一半。第一次启动后会记住启动要用到的模块，之后每次不再整体解压运行包，也不再用 PowerShell 查询自己刚启动的进程。运行环境较慢、杀毒软件拖慢文件读取的电脑受益更多。 - 更新页和提示：整包更新后如果还没能恢复你选的内核，会说明原因；两个“启动时检查”分别写清是哪一个；安装按钮写明要装的版本；选了更旧的版本时会有提示；网络问题显示为一句人话；更新失败时会说明现在用的版本不受影响，并附上详情。 - 数据导出：默认选“密码加密”；选普通文件且包含凭据时，会明确提醒凭据没有加密。 ## 升级与验证 ### 升级说明 - 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。整包更新后会自动恢复你选的内核。 - 升级后的第一次启动和以前一样慢一点（要重新学习启动用到的模块），第二次起变快。 正式成品已通过 Windows、macOS、Linux x64 与 ARM64 验收。升级会保留会话、设置、凭据、插件和工作区。 ## 下载 [**Windows x64 便携版（推荐）**](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/releases/download/v0.9.0/DSH-Portable-windows-x64.exe) 双击后会在旁边准备可移动的 `DSH-Portable` 文件夹。以后直接运行文件夹中的 `DeepSeek-Herness.exe`。

The preinstalled Image Viewer is now 0.1.11 and Chat Manager 1.5.12, both adapted to alpha.4. - Sign-in: clicking sign-in now opens the sign-in page in your default browser automatically, with no link to copy, and the sign-in window no longer spins forever. - Faster start: on the same PC the background is ready about twice as fast. After the first start it remembers the modules start-up needs instead of unpacking the whole runtime every time, and it no longer asks PowerShell about the process it just started. PCs with slow disks or antivirus scanning gain more. - Updates page and messages: after a full update it explains why your chosen core is not restored yet; the two startup checks say which one they control; the install button names the version; choosing an older version shows a hint; network problems read as a plain sentence; a failed update now says the version you use is unaffected and shows the details. - Data export: defaults to password encryption; choosing a plain file that includes credentials clearly warns that the credentials are not encrypted. ## Upgrade and verification ### Upgrade notes - Upgrading keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace. After a full update your chosen core is restored automatically. - The first start after upgrading is as slow as before while it learns the start-up modules; from the second start it is faster. Stable artifacts are verified on Windows, macOS, Linux x64, and Linux ARM64. 预装了两个默认插件，**默认关闭**：图片查看器 0.1.8、会话管理 1.5.8。在 **插件** 页打开即可使用。打开会话管理后请**重启一次应用**，之后已有会话才能永久删除。

- Run `DeepSeek Harness Portable.exe`. After a full exit you can move the whole folder to another place or Windows PC.
- Image Viewer 0.1.8 and Chat Manager 1.5.8 are preinstalled but **off**; turn them on in **Plugins**. After enabling Chat Manager, **restart the app once** before permanently deleting existing sessions.
- Known limits: the official default workspace lives in your system Documents folder (as with the installed app); `dsh://` links are handled by the portable app while it runs and restored after a normal exit; only one official app instance can run at a time.

Checksums are in `checksums.txt`.
